name: Merchandise Planning and OTB to the Norn canon

correspondences.justification: OTB budget consumption guard prevents committing purchase value above the remaining approved budget envelope.

residuals.note: The canon ontology pack has no bitemporal merchandise plan-version container class yet.
The canon ontology pack has no top-down spread conservation parent target class yet.
Internal merchandise plan target at entity x store x category x brand x ISO month grain; intentionally disjoint from norn.core.event and norn.core.commitment.
Internal purchase-at-cost budget target; not a financial claim or commitment amount.
Semi-additive planned end-of-month stock valuation target; the canon pack has no planned snapshot stock property yet.
Internal OTB purchase-at-cost budget ceiling; explicitly NOT norn.core.commitment (open supply.OrderLines remain the commitments consuming it).
Pack-level OTB budget consumption ledger binding supply.OrderLine commitments to plan.OtbEnvelope ceilings.
The canon ontology pack has no pinned plan-grain ML forecast revision class yet.
The canon ontology pack has no top-down plan spread conservation guard predicate yet.
